name: Immersion Course for Industry Practices
description: Overview of the Indian power sector structure; operational practices in generation, transmission, and distribution utilities; grid operation and load dispatch procedures; emerging trends such as renewable integration, digitalization, and smart grids; utility planning and asset management; electricity markets and tariff design; policy and regulatory processes; exposure to consultancy practices and project management; safety and quality standards in utility operations. The course will also include visits to control centres, expert lectures from industry professionals, and a short-term project or case study to consolidate experiential learning and enhance industry readiness.
